sentences.en: I am terribly busy because the report deadline is near.
sentences.zh: 因为报告最后期限快到了，我忙得要命。

sentences.en: I cannot agree to your proposal as regards the deadline.
sentences.zh: 关于截止日期，我不能同意你的提议。

sentences.en: You can't do this alone and still meet the deadline.
sentences.zh: 你一个人做不了这件事还指望按时完成？

senses.zh: 最后期限,截止期限,死线,原稿截止时间vt.通过设定一时间期限来统治
